decision.explanation: Document D2 explicitly states Irving Kaplansky attended the University of Toronto for his Bachelor's degree (D2S5) and Harvard University for his Ph.D. (D2S16). Document D1 describes a fictional narrative where he attends the University of Algarve; however, D2 identifies Kaplansky as a real historical figure (1917-2007) and provides verified biographical data, whereas D1 contains anachronistic details (e.g., 'early 1940s' arrival in Portugal for a Canadian mathematician) and reads as creative fiction. Per instructions to treat documents as fallible and distinguish between real-world facts and fictional assertions, only the institutions confirmed by the biographical source (D2) are accepted as valid answers to the factual question.
